definitions.explanation: The act of entering or approaching a specific area or zone. Used for vehicles, aircraft, or people entering a defined space, especially in transportation and traffic contexts.

examples.japanese: {進入|しんにゅう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{標識|ひょうしき}→標識：15865_hyoushiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑走路|かっそうろ}→滑走路：05980_kassouro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進入|しんにゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進入|しんにゅう}{路|ろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいた→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The on-ramp to the expressway was congested with traffic.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb used mainly in transportation, aviation, and traffic contexts. Describes authorized or neutral entry into a zone.

Do not confuse with ⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧ (intrusion/trespassing), which implies unauthorized or hostile entry. {進入|しんにゅう} is neutral or authorized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進入|しんにゅう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no entry)
- {進入|しんにゅう}{路|ろ} (approach road; on-ramp)
- {進入|しんにゅう}⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧ (approach angle)
- ⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧{進入|しんにゅう} (landing approach)
